edit.ability:
(OFS) both players draw 2 copies of Grapes.
Can always eat food.
Whenever the opponent uses a healing item, a copy of it is also used on this creature.
Immune to the negative effects of healing items.
Gain +0.5 ATK for every healing item used on this creature.
